name: Batch 12 · Electric affection
status: Published/imported and verified; 50 new unrated candidates. Not an approved party sequence.

selection_policy.grove: Upbeat, fun, happy, hopeful, loving and new beginnings; bouncy, melodic and sexy. No acid/techno; avoid chart-pop/top-five-hit character, sad music and negative central lyric narratives.
selection_policy.hollow: High energy, bouncy, hard, dark and fast. Direct rave/trance, hard bounce, acid/driving techno, two psytrance choices; no dedicated tech-house lane; no new DnB this round.
selection_policy.separation: Distinct rooms and moods; limited shared house vocabulary allowed. No duplicate recordings across rooms.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: Lyric themes, editorial sound hypotheses, catalog descriptors and actual-file analysis are separate. No complete exact-edit lyric or full listening certification.

selection_method: Completed host votes and explicit taste anchors; individually source exact catalog recordings, including suitable candidates from the privately cached saved-library pool. Selected Spotify identities/playability refreshed; this is not a fresh full saved-library export. A global Like never confers party approval. Weighted lane spacing and nearby credited-artist separation provide review variety.

primary_host_anchors: Now U Do — DJ Seinfeld, Confidence Man
feedback_basis.interpretation: Latest batch kept 11/50: vocal indie/electro 5/20, melodic club/garage 4/11, percussive 2/8, playful electronic-pop 0/11. Follow individual Yelle, Chairlift, Hot Chip, Great DJ, Sometimes and modern vocal-club Keeps; reduce whimsical/novelty-pop probes and avoid repeating the large familiar indie crossover sweep. No artist-wide approval or new genre prohibition.

audit.listening_status: Catalog identity/metadata checked; no complete audio audition, acoustic identity proof or rendered mix.

privacy_note: Full saved-library exports, personal source membership/timestamps, OAuth data, feedback backups and lyric caches stay ignored. Portable candidates contain no individual saved-state flags or lyric transcripts. Artist genre lookups include dated cached API evidence.
